<article class="chapter" id="page-26" aria-labelledby="title-26"><div class="page-marker">PORTFOLIO / 26</div><p class="eyebrow" data-editable="" spellcheck="true">SECTION VI | ROADMAP 6 OF 6</p>
<h2 id="title-26" data-editable="" spellcheck="true">Measurement, assurance, and strategic synthesis</h2><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">The roadmap should be evaluated through a balanced evidence set. Faster processing is relevant only when records remain accurate, applicants receive understandable information, and recovery remains credible. Management should compare performance with a measured baseline and record changes in volume, complexity, staffing, and system scope that affect interpretation.</p><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">A monthly dashboard reports median handling time, exception age, sampled error rates, access-review completion, verified leaver revocation, restore performance, and unresolved high-risk findings. Each metric has a defined denominator and an owner. For example, leaver compliance means verified revocation for all people whose access should have ended during the period, not merely the percentage of tickets marked complete.</p><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">Benefits governance separates capacity, cash, and quality. Finance confirms avoided expenditure using records such as overtime or hiring plans. Operations confirms whether released hours improved service or reduced backlogs. Compliance monitors complaints and disclosure events. A benefit cannot be counted in two categories without explaining the relationship, and a reduced backlog cannot be attributed entirely to automation if staffing or demand also changed.</p><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">The central synthesis is that cloud computing, automation, cybersecurity, and AI ethics form one managerial system. Cloud architecture determines where information can move; automation determines how quickly action follows; cybersecurity determines how misuse is constrained and investigated; AI governance determines which judgments remain accountable and contestable. Weakness in one area can undo the value created by the others.</p><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">The roadmap therefore makes a conditional recommendation: authorize foundational work and a bounded pilot, then release later funding only when evidence supports expansion. This approach allows the enterprise to learn without committing prematurely to an unsuitable platform or a misleading benefit forecast. It also provides a defensible explanation to employees and applicants about why particular changes are introduced and what protections accompany them.</p><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">For the ETEEAP candidate, the learning outcome is the ability to defend this integrated reasoning. The final oral presentation should explain a tradeoff, reconstruct a calculation, respond to an incident scenario, and identify a limitation in the evidence. The strongest demonstration of leadership is not certainty about every answer, but disciplined judgment about what is known, what must be tested, and who is accountable for the next decision.</p></article>

<article class="chapter" id="page-29" aria-labelledby="title-29"><div class="page-marker">PORTFOLIO / 29</div><p class="eyebrow" data-editable="" spellcheck="true">REFERENCES | APA 7</p>
<h2 id="title-29" data-editable="" spellcheck="true">Legal authorities and use of sources</h2><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">Republic Act No. 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012 (2012) (Phil.).<br><a href="https://privacy.gov.ph/data-privacy-act/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">https://privacy.gov.ph/data-privacy-act/</a></p><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">Republic Act No. 10175, Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012 (2012) (Phil.).<br><a href="https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2012/ra_10175_2012.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2012/ra_10175_2012.html</a></p><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">Supreme Court of the Philippines. (2001). <i>Rules on electronic evidence</i> (A.M. No. 01-7-01-SC).<br><a href="https://lawphil.net/courts/supreme/am/am_01-7-01_sc_2001.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">https://lawphil.net/courts/supreme/am/am_01-7-01_sc_2001.html</a></p>
<h3 data-editable="" spellcheck="true">How the references support the analysis</h3><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">CHED provides the general education framework for the provisional competency mapping. RA 10173 and NPC materials support the privacy principles and breach-notification distinction. RA 10175 supports the cybercrime context. The Rules on Electronic Evidence support the discussion of authentication and reliable handling, subject to the applicable proceeding and legal review.</p><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">NIST CSF 2.0 and AI RMF 1.0 supply voluntary organizing frameworks. The proposed roles, budgets, thresholds, test criteria, and schedule are original case-study recommendations; they are not represented as requirements prescribed by those publications. SIFT supplies a method for checking information before relying on it in enterprise decisions.</p>
<h3 data-editable="" spellcheck="true">Scope and academic integrity</h3><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">This portfolio is a design-based academic analysis. It contains no verified company audit, employee interview study, supplier quotation, completed implementation, or measured performance improvement. Financial and operational assumptions are deliberately visible so that they can be replaced and challenged. References should be rechecked before real deployment, especially where later issuances, court rulings, contractual duties, or foreign law may affect implementation.</p><p data-editable="" spellcheck="true">A submission-ready version must preserve this distinction between evidence and proposal. Authentic workplace artifacts demonstrate prior learning; a well-reasoned case study demonstrates analytical competence. Both can contribute to assessment, but neither should be presented as the other.</p></article>

<script id="portfolio-editor">
(() => {
  const selector = '.chapter h2,.chapter h3,.chapter p,.chapter li,.chapter td,.chapter th,.sidebar .identity,.sidebar .brand,.sidebar > p,.sidebar .status,.intro p,footer,.masthead > p';
  const candidates = [...document.querySelectorAll(selector)];
  const fields = candidates.filter(el => !candidates.some(other => other !== el && el.contains(other)));
  let editing = false, dirty = false;
  const status = document.getElementById('edit-status');
  const toggle = document.getElementById('edit-toggle');
  function mode(on) {
    editing = on;
    fields.forEach(el => { el.dataset.editable = ''; el.contentEditable = on ? 'plaintext-only' : 'false'; el.spellcheck = true; });
    toggle.textContent = on ? 'Preview' : 'Edit content';
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(on));
  }
  fields.forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('input', () => {dirty = true; status.textContent = 'Changes pending — download to keep them';});
    el.addEventListener('click', e => {if(editing && e.target.closest('a')) e.preventDefault();});
  });
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => mode(!editing));
  document.getElementById('print-edited').addEventListener('click', () => window.print());
  document.getElementById('download-html').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const copy = document.documentElement.cloneNode(true);
    copy.querySelectorAll('[data-editable]').forEach(el => el.removeAttribute('contenteditable'));
    copy.querySelector('#edit-status').textContent = 'Ready to edit';
    copy.querySelector('#edit-toggle').textContent = 'Edit content';
    copy.querySelector('#edit-toggle').setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    const blob = new Blob(['<!doctype html>\n' + copy.outerHTML], {type:'text/html;charset=utf-8'});
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'index.html';
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10000);
    dirty = false; status.textContent = 'Download requested — keep the downloaded file';
  });
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', e => {if(dirty){e.preventDefault();e.returnValue = '';}});
  mode(false);
})();
</script>

<script>
(() => {
  // Host colors are defaults; later authored styles can give the same names
  // their own meaning (for example, --muted as a chart's label color).
  const hostStyles = document.getElementById("codex-visualization-host-theme");
  const hostStyle = hostStyles.sheet.cssRules[0].style;
  // Typography, geometry and interaction cursors still follow the host.
  const styleForProperty = (property) =>
    /^--(?:font-|radius|corner-shape$|control-spacing$|cursor-interaction$|icon-size$|page-content-inline-inset$|page-header-clearance$|visualize-paint-gutter$)/.test(property)
      ? document.documentElement.style
      : hostStyle;
  const initialGlobals =
    globalThis.__codexVisualizationInitialGlobals ?? globalThis.openai;
  delete globalThis.__codexVisualizationInitialGlobals;
  if (initialGlobals?.statePersistence != null) {
    globalThis.openai ??= {};
    globalThis.openai.statePersistence = initialGlobals.statePersistence;
    globalThis.openai.stateModelContext = initialGlobals.stateModelContext ?? "none";
  }
  if (!false) {
    return;
  }
  let appliedProperties = [];
  const applyHostStyleVariables = (styleVariables) => {
    if (styleVariables == null || typeof styleVariables !== "object") {
      return;
    }
    document.documentElement.toggleAttribute(
      "data-visualize-page-inline-inset", typeof styleVariables["--page-content-inline-inset"] === "string",
    );
    document.documentElement.toggleAttribute(
      "data-visualize-page-header", typeof styleVariables["--page-header-clearance"] === "string",
    );
    for (const property of appliedProperties) {
      styleForProperty(property).removeProperty(property);
    }
    appliedProperties = [];
    for (const [property, value] of Object.entries(styleVariables)) {
      if (property.startsWith("--") && typeof value === "string") {
        styleForProperty(property).setProperty(property, value);
        appliedProperties.push(property);
      }
    }
  };

  const syncHostStyles = (globals) => {
    applyHostStyleVariables(globals?.visualizationStyleVariables);
    const sandboxDocument = globalThis.frameElement?.ownerDocument;
    if (sandboxDocument != null && globals?.visualizationTheme != null) {
      let colorSchemeMeta = sandboxDocument.querySelector(
        'meta[name="color-scheme"]',
      );
      if (colorSchemeMeta == null) {
        colorSchemeMeta = sandboxDocument.createElement("meta");
        colorSchemeMeta.name = "color-scheme";
        sandboxDocument.head.appendChild(colorSchemeMeta);
      }
      colorSchemeMeta.content = globals.visualizationTheme;
      sandboxDocument.documentElement.style.colorScheme =
        globals.visualizationTheme;
      // Paint the host surface behind transparent saved visualization documents.
      sandboxDocument.documentElement.style.backgroundColor =
        hostStyle.getPropertyValue("--background");
    }
  };

  syncHostStyles(initialGlobals);
  globalThis.addEventListener("openai:set_globals", (event) => {
    syncHostStyles(event.detail?.globals);
  });
})();
</script>




<script>
(() => {
  const reportEnvironmentError = (value) => {
    const error = value instanceof Error ? value : new Error(String(value));
    void globalThis.openai
      .callTool(
        "__codex_inline_visualization_error__",
        {
          message: error.message,
          name: error.name,
          stack: error.stack,
        },
      )
      .catch(() => {});
  };

  globalThis.addEventListener("error", (event) => {
    if (event.target?.localName === "script") {
      // A script's own onerror may render a fallback or load an alternative.
      // Let that handler run; failures it throws still reach the global error path.
      const handlesError = typeof event.target.onerror === "function";
      globalThis.queueMicrotask(() => {
        if (!handlesError && !event.defaultPrevented) {
          reportEnvironmentError("Visualization script could not be loaded");
        }
      });
    } else if (event.target === globalThis) {
      // The browser defers resize notifications to another frame; no script threw.
      if (event.error == null && (
        event.message === "ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications." ||
        event.message === "ResizeObserver loop limit exceeded"
      )) {
        return;
      }
      reportEnvironmentError(event.error ?? event.message);
    }
  }, true);
  globalThis.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (event) => {
    reportEnvironmentError(event.reason);
  });
})();
</script>
<script id="codex-visualization-variants">
(() => {
  let previousSnapshot = "[]";
  let roots = [];
  const report = () => {
    roots = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(".viz-carousel[data-active-variant]"),
    ).slice(0, 32);
    const selectedVariants = roots.flatMap((root, carousel) => {
      const variant = root.dataset.activeVariant;
      const label = root.getAttribute("aria-label")?.slice(0, 256);
      return variant ? [{
        carousel,
        ...(label == null ? {} : { label }),
        variant: variant.slice(0, 256),
      }] : [];
    });
    const snapshot = JSON.stringify(selectedVariants);
